rationale: TTEK gapped up 10.01% at the open on 5.88x relative volume but immediately failed to hold gains, selling off into the bottom 16.6% of its intraday range and remaining sustained below both session VWAP ($39.30) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($38.87). With the broader market weak and recent 1-minute candles rejecting the 9-EMA to make lower lows, the path of least resistance is a continuation down to fill the open gap toward the prior close of $37.61. Invalidation is placed just above session VWAP at $39.35 to cap risk if buyers reclaim control.
